I've spent the last several months building and stress-testing local AI workflows focused on auditability, recovery, provenance, and preventing fragile automation from silently corrupting state.

I'm offering a short architectural review for people building agents, local LLM systems, RAG pipelines, or Python/PowerShell automation.

Send me a short description of the system and its current failure point. I'll spend about 30-60 minutes reviewing your repository, architecture document, or design description and return:

* major failure risks
* unnecessary complexity
* observability gaps
* recovery recommendations
* questions I think deserve investigation

Pricing: If you want to donate that's cool, otherwise you're welcome to it for free.

No mailing list, auto-subscribe link, or upsell.
